name: Gen1 Co-op (prototype)
description: Experimental overworld co-op prototype for up to 10 players, LAN or internet. Fully in-game menu: START > GEN1COOP > HOST (LAN) or JOIN (a LAN IP, or a relay_server.py address for internet play with viewers/friends - no VPN or port forwarding needed) or JOUEURS (see who's connected and their color). Other connected players now show up as colored markers on the map while you share their location; each player has a fixed color (see assets/sprites/).
